levels.title: First Spark
levels.description: Launch one pulse and fill one Goal Target.

levels.title: Follow the Current
levels.description: Follow a longer route through Normal nodes.

levels.title: Choose Your Begin
levels.description: Only one Begin can launch; find the route that reaches the Goal.

levels.title: False Shortcuts
levels.description: Three starting points; only one route reaches the Goal.

levels.title: Two Destinations
levels.description: A Splitter produces two pulses to fill two Goals.

levels.title: The Two Routes
levels.description: One Splitter, two routes of different lengths, and two Goals.

levels.title: Twice to Win
levels.description: A two-hit Goal requires both pulses from one Splitter.

levels.title: Chain Reaction
levels.description: Rotate the first Splitter, then use two Splitters to reach three Goals.

levels.title: The Missing Connection
levels.description: One grey port blocks the goal. Rotate the Alternating Node to open the route.

levels.title: One Way Out
levels.description: A closed port blocks arrivals too. Choose the right Begin and turn the switch to reach both Goals.

levels.title: The Changing Current
levels.description: Two pulses arrive at one switch at different times. Its grey arm advances after the first crossing.

levels.title: Three Steps Ahead
levels.description: Configure two switches so a Splitter can send a pulse to each Goal.
